name: FutaOS
source:
You decided to buy a new phone, but there was something you forgot….
Recent changes to the law now require all single individuals to find a girlfriend.
Lucky for you, your new phone comes with FutR, a dating app filled with Futanari.
Will you be able to find a Futa girlfriend?
Good luck!
